filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. For English, there was a wealth of high-quality, high-viewcount videos for all topics. For Arabic, coverage was good but required careful filtering to distinguish between relevant topics (e.g., Boolean CNF vs. Grammar CNF) and to handle very long lecture videos that failed the duration gate. One advanced topic, Randomized Turing Machines, had no Arabic candidates.
